title: Hotline settings (v1)
description: User configuration in settings.json (unit: JSON object).

language.description: Interface language tag or 'system' to follow Windows (unit: BCP 47 tag).

supportReminder.description: User preference for showing the support reminder (unit: boolean).

activation.description: Copilot key and fallback hotkey actions (unit: object).

tap.description: Action for Copilot key short press (unit: action enum).

hold.description: Action for Copilot key long press (unit: action enum).

fallbackHotkey.description: Optional global fallback hotkey combo, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+H' (unit: hotkey string).

window.description: Panel size, placement, sound and appearance (unit: object).

width.description: Opening panel width in scaled pixels (200-4000) or share of screen work area ('20%'-'90%') (unit: scaled px or percent).

chatWidth.description: Panel width when a chat starts, in scaled pixels (200-4000) or percent ('20%'-'90%'); null keeps opening width (unit: scaled px or percent).

minWidth.description: Minimum clamp for width and chatWidth (unit: scaled px).

maxWidth.description: Maximum clamp for width and chatWidth (unit: scaled px).

minHeight.description: Minimum panel height; 0 fits the message bar (unit: scaled px).

maxHeightPercent.description: Maximum panel height as a share of screen work area (unit: percent).

chatHeight.description: Maximum chat height; null uses maxHeightPercent (unit: scaled px).

growMode.description: Whether panel fits conversation or jumps to full height when chatting (unit: enum).

growDirection.description: Direction chat expands from the message bar (unit: enum).

anchor.description: Default panel placement anchor on screen (unit: anchor object).

monitor.description: Monitor target: 'active', 'primary', or device name (unit: monitor identifier).

x.description: Horizontal fraction of free work area (unit: fraction 0-1).

y.description: Vertical fraction of free work area (unit: fraction 0-1).

openSound.description: Sound played on open: 'off', 'windows:<event>', or '.wav' file in sounds\ (unit: sound identifier).

closeSound.description: Sound played on close: 'off', 'windows:<event>', or '.wav' file in sounds\ (unit: sound identifier).

hideOnBlur.description: Hide panel when another window receives focus (unit: boolean).

alwaysOnTop.description: Keep panel above other windows (unit: boolean).

accent.description: Accent colour: 'hotline', 'windows', or '#RRGGBB' (unit: colour token or hex).

fontSize.description: Chat text size; null follows Windows text size (unit: scaled px).

fontFamily.description: Chat font family; null uses Segoe UI Variable (unit: font family name).

verboseLogging.description: Write DEBUG lines to hotline.log and show key-status line (unit: boolean).

testLinks.description: Enable diagnostic protocol links such as hotline://selftest (unit: boolean).

chat.description: Conversation, history, selection, OCR and memory options (unit: object).

defaultConnection.description: Default connection id; empty asks on first open (unit: connection id).

defaultPrompt.description: System prompt name in prompts\ for connections without one (unit: prompt name).

continueIn.description: Shared 'Continue this chat in' targets; null uses Local connection default (unit: target array).

order.description: Connection ids in Provider dropdown order (unit: id array).

notifyWhenDone.description: Show Windows toast when answer finishes while panel is hidden or unfocused (unit: boolean).

notifyShowsText.description: Include answer text in completion toast; false shows title only (unit: boolean).

historyListSize.description: Maximum saved chats read for the history list (unit: count).

thinkingIndicator.description: Show spinning cursor while streaming has no new text (unit: boolean).

thinkingDelayMs.description: Delay without streaming text before thinking indicator appears (unit: ms).

resumeWhileTyping.description: Open history search immediately when typing '/resume ' (unit: boolean).

cliTranscripts.description: Read earlier messages from CLI history for record-only chats (unit: boolean).

historyRetentionDays.description: Age after which saved history files are deleted (unit: days).

maxImagePixels.description: Maximum longest edge for attached and captured images (unit: px).

attachSelection.description: Selected text capture mode on panel open (unit: enum).

ocr.description: Offline Windows OCR mode for screenshots (unit: enum).

voiceAutoSend.description: Send dictated message automatically on key release (unit: boolean).

memory.description: Include memory.md in every chat's system prompt (unit: boolean).

memoryTool.description: Whether API models may write to memory.md via remember tool (unit: enum).

approvals.description: Tool approval rules keyed by 'server/tool' or 'server/*' (unit: approval map).

name.description: Display label in Continue this chat in menu (unit: string).

url.description: URL template for web or base URL for openWebUi (unit: URL).

command.description: Executable and arguments for app target (unit: command string).

model.description: Optional model override for openWebUi (unit: model id).

copyChat.description: Copy chat Markdown to clipboard before launching (unit: boolean).
